name: A Western couple at a table; on the back, a young Western woman drawing flowers
summary: A sketch of a woman seated at a pedestal table, with a man standing beside her; on the back, a drawing of a woman resting a sketchbook on the arm of a sofa as she draws a vase of flowers placed on a table nearby.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
